_comment: Synthetic agronomy catalog for the hybrid-commerce demo. Every brand, product, rate, and figure here is invented for this demo and corresponds to no real crop-protection product. Rate ranges are machine-readable (rate_min/rate_max/rate_unit) so the application-plan calculator computes volumes in code rather than in the model.

products.title: Vantage Pro SC Residual Herbicide
products.short_description: Long-residual preemergence grass and small-seeded broadleaf control for corn acres.
products.long_description: A suspension concentrate that sets a residual barrier ahead of waterhemp and foxtail flushes. Apply to a clean seedbed within seven days of planting. Rate climbs with organic matter and expected weed pressure; the high end of the range suits heavy waterhemp history.

products.title: Clearfront XL Preemergence Premix
products.short_description: Two modes of action in one jug for resistance management on continuous corn.
products.long_description: Pairs a Group 4 and a Group 15 so a single pass carries two effective sites against broadleaf escapes. Intended for fields with a documented Group 15 resistance concern.

products.title: Rowguard 4L Soybean Residual
products.short_description: Preemergence residual that holds soybean acres clean through canopy.
products.long_description: Activates with a half inch of rainfall or irrigation within ten days. On coarse soils with low organic matter, stay at the low end of the range.

products.title: Sweepline SG Postemergence Herbicide
products.short_description: Postemergence cleanup on escapes up to four inches, with a required adjuvant load.
products.long_description: Performance falls off sharply on weeds taller than four inches. The label requires both a nonionic surfactant and an ammonium sulfate water conditioner; plan the tank accordingly.

products.title: Thistledown 2EC Cereal Herbicide
products.short_description: Perennial broadleaf control in cereals, with a rotation interval to respect.
products.long_description: Carries a nine-month rotation restriction to soybean. Confirm the following crop before recommending on rented ground.

products.title: Broadmark DF Dry Flowable Herbicide
products.short_description: Dry flowable broadleaf cleanup that mixes light in the tank.
products.long_description: A dry formulation for operations that would rather not handle another liquid jug. Requires thorough agitation during fill.

products.title: Canopy Shield SC Fungicide

attributes.target: gray leaf spot, frogeye leaf spot

products.short_description: Two-mode foliar fungicide for the R1 to R3 window.
products.long_description: Best return comes from an application timed to disease onset rather than the calendar. Two modes of action support a resistance-management plan.

products.title: Strobe Guard EC Fungicide
products.short_description: Single-mode fungicide priced for broad-acre preventive passes.
products.long_description: A single site of action, so alternate with a different group within the same season to protect the chemistry.

products.title: Tassel Defense Corn Fungicide
products.short_description: Tar spot program fungicide for the tassel window.
products.long_description: Built for tar spot pressure in the VT to R2 window. Coverage matters: hold at least fifteen gallons of carrier per acre on a ground rig.

products.title: Aphid Halt 2F Insecticide

attributes.pollinator_note: do not apply to a blooming crop while pollinators are foraging

products.short_description: Aphid control at the 250-per-plant treatment threshold.
products.long_description: Scout to threshold before applying. The label restricts application to a blooming crop while pollinators are actively foraging.

products.title: Rootworm Sentry Soil Insecticide
products.short_description: In-furrow rootworm protection applied through planter equipment.
products.long_description: Applied in-furrow at planting through a calibrated liquid system. Not a rescue treatment for larvae already feeding.

products.title: Beetle Line CS Restricted-Use Insecticide
products.short_description: Restricted-use product; a certified applicator licence is required to buy and apply it.
products.long_description: A restricted-use pesticide. Purchase and application require a current certified applicator licence on file, which the portal verifies before an order can be completed.

products.title: Sticktite NIS Nonionic Surfactant
products.short_description: Standard nonionic surfactant for postemergence tank mixes.
products.long_description: Rated as a percentage of finished spray volume rather than per acre, so the carrier volume drives the amount needed.

products.title: Driftless DRA Drift Reduction Agent
products.short_description: Coarsens the droplet spectrum to hold spray on target.
products.long_description: Supports a drift-management plan near sensitive areas. Does not replace the nozzle and pressure requirements on a product label.

products.title: AMS Boost Water Conditioner
products.short_description: Ammonium sulfate conditioner that goes in the tank before the herbicide.
products.long_description: Conditions hard carrier water so Group 9 chemistry is not tied up by calcium and magnesium. Rated per hundred gallons of carrier, not per acre.

products.title: MSO Concentrate Methylated Seed Oil
products.short_description: Oil adjuvant for waxy leaf surfaces and tough late escapes.
products.long_description: Improves uptake on hardened weed cuticles. Raises crop-response risk under hot conditions, so check the herbicide label before substituting it for a surfactant.

products.title: Emerge Coat ST Seed Treatment
products.short_description: Seedling disease protection applied on seed, rated per hundredweight.
products.long_description: Rated per hundredweight of seed rather than per acre, so the seeding rate drives the amount needed.

products.title: Nodule Start Soybean Inoculant
products.short_description: Live rhizobia inoculant for fields out of soybean more than three years.
products.long_description: A living product with real storage limits. Returns the clearest response on ground that has been out of soybean for three years or more.

products.title: ZincLift 9% Chelated Micronutrient
products.short_description: Chelated zinc for high-pH and high-phosphorus ground.
products.long_description: Most responsive on high-pH soils and fields with a history of high phosphorus. A soil test should support the application.

products.title: BoroFlow Liquid Boron
products.short_description: Foliar boron with a narrow window between deficiency and excess.
products.long_description: Boron has a narrow margin between sufficiency and toxicity. Do not exceed the labeled seasonal maximum across combined applications.

products.title: SulfurPlus 12-0-0-26S Liquid
products.short_description: Bulk liquid sulfur for sandy and low-organic-matter ground.
products.long_description: Sold by the tote for operations running liquid sidedress. Sulfur response is clearest on sandy, low-organic-matter soils.

products.title: AirSpread AIXR Spray Nozzle Set
products.short_description: Air-induction flat fan nozzles in the four orifice sizes most rigs run.
products.long_description: Orifice size sets the carrier volume at a given pressure and speed. Match the orifice to the gallons per acre the product label requires.

products.title: Chemical-Resistant Nitrile Gloves
products.short_description: Gauntlet-length nitrile gloves that meet handler requirements on most labels.
products.long_description: Fourteen mil nitrile with a thirteen-inch cuff, which is what most product labels specify for mixing and loading.

products.title: TankClear Sprayer Cleanout Concentrate
products.short_description: Cleanout concentrate for switching between sensitive crops.
products.long_description: A triple-rinse with this concentrate is the standard step before moving a rig from a corn herbicide to soybean acres.

products.title: Inline Sprayer Filter Screen Kit
products.short_description: Replacement screens in the two mesh sizes most tank mixes call for.
products.long_description: Dry flowable products generally want the coarser fifty mesh; check the label before dropping to eighty.

products.title: Full Face Shield with Chemical Splash Guard
products.short_description: Face and eye protection for mixing and loading concentrate.
products.long_description: Required handler protection on many concentrate labels during mixing and loading.

products.title: Chemical-Resistant Coveralls
products.short_description: Single-use coveralls sold by the case for handler protection.
products.long_description: Single-use protective coveralls. Sold by the case of twelve.

products.title: Sprayer Calibration Kit

attributes.includes: flow cup, catch container, timer, chart
attributes.use: verify gallons per acre before a pass

products.short_description: Verifies the rig is actually putting out the carrier volume the label assumes.
products.long_description: Every rate recommendation assumes the rig is calibrated. This kit checks output per nozzle against the target gallons per acre.

products.title: Closed Transfer Coupler
products.short_description: Closed-system transfer coupling that cuts handler exposure during fill.
products.long_description: Reduces handler contact with concentrate during mixing and loading, and keeps rinse water in the system.
